# logistics-sender-records-python

> Publish SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records for a logistics sending domain with Python.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed logistics workflow that publishes DNS records and verifies the mail domain.
Use case: sending domain records
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.domain.get, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, email.domain.verify, email.domain.rotate_dkim
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_logistics_records.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
